name: ms_no_param_y2_x3_1
statement: {k : Type*} [Field k] (h2 : ringChar k ≠ 2) (h3 : ringChar k ≠ 3) (f g : RatFunc k) (heq : g ^ 2 = f ^ 3 + 1) : (∃ c : k, f = RatFunc.C c) ∧ (∃ d : k, g = RatFunc.C d)
closed: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] (h2 : ringChar k ≠ 2) (h3 : ringChar k ≠ 3) (f g : RatFunc k) (heq : g ^ 2 = f ^ 3 + 1), (∃ c : k, f = RatFunc.C c) ∧ (∃ d : k, g = RatFunc.C d)
informal: If char k ≠ 2,3 and rational functions f,g in k(t) satisfy g^2 = f^3 + 1 then f and g are constants.
original: Theorem 3 (Non-parametrizablility of an Elliptic Curve). Let k be a field of characteristic ≠ 2, 3. If rational functions f(t), g(t) ∈ k(t) satisfy g(t)^2 = f(t)^3 + 1, then both f(t) and g(t) are constants in k.
